verdicts.decision_note: The client requests production-ready diagrams for the platform and agent solution pages; the tightly coupled follow-up identifies the platform diagram as the customer/staff communication diagram.
The freelancer explicitly requests clarification of the customer labels and staff-icon meanings for the communication diagram.
The client explicitly specifies the customer and staff communication labels and their conditional use.
The client's direct answer resolves the material label uncertainty and returns the diagram requirement to active work.
